us-lf-10540.summary: The County’s project record identifies difficulties with an RNG development at North Dade and continued interest in other uses. A smaller on-site power project is a hypothesis to evaluate; available gas and acceptable terms remain unconfirmed.
us-lf-10540.first_step: Ask Saba Musleh which process now applies specifically to North Dade, whether alternative gas uses can be considered, and who can authorize a technical discussion.

nodes.name: Miami-Dade County — Solid Waste Management
nodes.title: Landfill owner and operator
nodes.evidence_note: County facility information and draft scope identify County ownership and operation; exact North Dade address is 21500 NW 47th Avenue. Gas allocations and contracting delegation are separate questions.
nodes.next_action: Request the current gas-rights agreements, allocations and the North Dade approval route.

nodes.name: Saba Musleh
nodes.title: Negotiator, Strategic Procurement
nodes.evidence_note: Named negotiator in the gas-project memorandum. Business phone and email are published in County procurement material; no signing authority established.
nodes.next_action: Confirm the current North Dade procurement status, permitted communication route and contact authorized to discuss alternative uses.

nodes.name: Ravi Kadambala
nodes.title: Division Director, Technical Services & Environmental Affairs
nodes.evidence_note: Current County directory supplies the role and office number. County-published correspondence corroborates the email.
nodes.next_action: Through the permitted route, request recent gas-flow and composition records, decline assumptions, treatment needs and the appropriate technical project lead.

nodes.name: Jeremiah Reed
nodes.title: Chief 3, Landfills
nodes.evidence_note: Current County directory lists responsibility for landfill operations. Site-specific delegation is not established.
nodes.next_action: Identify the current gas-system operator, operating constraints and the person who can arrange a technical visit.

nodes.name: Aneisha Daniel
nodes.title: Director, Solid Waste Management
nodes.evidence_note: Current County directory confirms the department role and office number. The February 2026 director directory supplies the email; support for Proton is unknown.
nodes.next_action: After the technical and procurement route is established, confirm department priorities and the commercial approval process.

nodes.name: Frank Calderon
nodes.title: Public Records Custodian, Solid Waste Management
nodes.evidence_note: County directory identifies the records custodian and published office phone. This is a records route, not an approval contact.
nodes.next_action: Request the current North Dade gas agreements, engineering/O&M contract references and any subsequent decision record.

nodes.name: Board of County Commissioners / authorized County delegate
nodes.title: North Dade approval route to confirm
nodes.evidence_note: The adopted July action concerns South Dade. The exact approval and signing route for a new North Dade arrangement must be confirmed with procurement.
nodes.next_action: Obtain the applicable approval steps and written delegation for North Dade; do not infer them from the South Dade action.

open_questions: Who currently controls the gas, and what quantities are uncommitted?
What became of North Dade after EVN0019329 and the July 2026 amendment?
Who is the current gas-system O&M contractor and engineering contact?
What gas flow, methane fraction, contaminants and decline can be supported by current measurements?
Who can approve and sign a North Dade agreement, and through which procurement route?

context.note: The July 21 record, item 8P9 / File 261339, shows an adopted direction to negotiate a South Dade contract. It does not prove a North Dade contract or an open North Dade solicitation.
The supporting memorandum discusses North Dade RNG feasibility concerns and other possible uses. A modular mining proposal still requires engineering and commercial validation.
The earlier future-solicitation scope is a draft. Its gas quantities, rents and proposed term are not current quotes or commitments.
